'''Jagiellonia Białystok''' ({{IPA|pol|jaɡʲɛ(l)ˈlɔɲa bjaˈwɨstɔk}}) is a Polish professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Białystok]] that plays in the [[Ekstraklasa]], the top level of [[football in Poland|Polish football]]. The club was founded in 1920 by soldiers in the [[42nd Infantry Regiment (Poland)|42nd Infantry Regiment]] Reserve Battalion in Białystok. Jagiellonia play their home games at the [[Stadion Miejski (Białystok)|Chorten Arena]].

Jagiellonia is the most accomplished football club of north-eastern Poland. The club won the Polish Cup and Super Cup in 2010 and qualified to play in the third qualification round of the [[UEFA Europa League]], their first appearance in European competition. The club's most successful season was the [[2023–24 Ekstraklasa]] when they were crowned champions for the first time in the club's history."}}
